definitions.gloss: employee ID card; company ID badge
definitions.explanation: An identification card issued by a company to its employees, used for building access, identity verification, and other workplace purposes.

examples.japanese: {社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: You can't enter the building without your employee ID.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}→返却：03149_henkyaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: You must return your employee ID card when you resign.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (company employee) and {証|しょう} (proof/certificate). In many Japanese companies, the {社員証|しゃいんしょう} doubles as a security access card and is worn on a lanyard around the neck.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提示|ていじ}する→提示する：26842_teijisuru⟧: to present one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧: to forget one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返却|へんきゃく}する→返却する：21323_henkyakusuru⟧: to return one's employee ID
- {社員証|しゃいんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かざす→かざす：28115_kazasu⟧: to hold up one's employee ID (to a reader)
